items.title: Ken Poston interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2024
items.q: I bought Bill Russo’s How to Arrange for Jazz Orchestra... Russo’s book is not that easy to digest... I actually wrote a chart.

ctx.x: Was there a point when you were trying to play along that you started to realize the relationship between the trumpet notes and the background? The chords or the bass line?

When I got into coll — or into high school I started to get more and more curious about some of those things. And I remember going to the Walden Book Store in the mall and I bought Bill Russo’s How to Arrange for Jazz Orchestra. And I actually wrote a chart. And my teacher helped me a little bit, and there was a student teacher there at the time that helped me a little bit, but I didn’t know what I was doing at all, and Russo’s book is not that easy to digest, especially when you don’t know anything, but it…
Can you recall the name of the chart? Was it a chart that something else you were arranging — another tune?
